levels.name: Warm Up
levels.teaser: Tutorial room in two halves: jar and Key, two bolt-cutter halves, the chained door and a 3x3 sliding lock.

levels.name: Escape Room
levels.teaser: Jail cell. Book spines, hidden handle, world map jigsaw and the 514 safe.

levels.name: William's Apartment
levels.teaser: City apartment. Card-suit dial lock 727, keypad 2519, 4x4 symbol panel, two bottles and phone code 35721.

levels.name: High School
levels.teaser: Classroom, corridor and trophy cabinet. Arcade maze gives 1590, blackboard cipher, globe 20/17/39, locker panel and hex tiles.

levels.name: Yacht
levels.teaser: One code only: 58137 down the orange life vest opens the steel keypad by the stairs. Four sand jars, the bell shelf, the shark tank and three shelves of bottles fill the rest of the boat.

levels.name: Amusement Park
levels.teaser: Six numbers and a circuit: the blue ticket machine takes 1496, the photo-booth strips give 20 / 67 / 81 for the strength tester, and the ring toss board has to reach 150 before the exit opens.

levels.name: The Game Night Agency
levels.teaser: Safe code 55793 sits on a crumpled note under the board-game shelf, beside the Scrabble box. A 4x4 card board, a fox tangram, slide blocks and six letter notes (H=C, M=T) make up the rest of the office.

levels.name: Log Cabin
levels.teaser: Two codes in one room: 1746 on the desk laptop and 358429 on the door keypad. Eight glass pieces feed the hex panel and the red safe takes a twelve-button paw code.

levels.name: Junkyard
levels.teaser: JWFMI opens the letter lock on the trailer door and 99452 opens the yellow panel beside the crane. The steering maze, the ring puzzle and the crane parts tray fill out the yard.

levels.name: Train Station
levels.teaser: Nothing to crack: the note, the slot number, the chest code 77059 and the cup order are all handed to you, and the work is matching each one to the right object.

levels.name: Lighthouse
levels.teaser: The last lock is a colour pairing, not a number: five fuse colours on a paper match five buttons on the bomb panel. Wheel and Handle, Candle and Lighter, the lettered books and the candle chart fill the two floors.

levels.name: Cell Phone Store
levels.teaser: Cell Phone Store: a phone with no SIM, a handbag on the sofa, a 3x3 pattern lock that prints the six-digit passcode, then a fifteen-button wall panel hiding the front-door key.

levels.name: Cinemas
levels.teaser: Cinema lobby: a key off the peg rack with the selfie stick, a ticket printer and seat chart, a running-total terminal, a burnt BURNING CITY poster and the four-digit exit code it hides.

levels.name: Pharmacy
levels.teaser: Pharmacy: a circled letter on a word-search, HEALTH on the steel keyboard, four numbered pills and an eight-digit keypad, the multivitamin wall, and a three-digit colour lock on 438.

levels.name: Optical Store
levels.teaser: Optical Store: a key pegged on the eyewear shelf, the five-digit code 68459 inside the locked glasses cabinet, the refractor lens drawer, the phoropter readings and a safe that spells T-O-D.

levels.name: Gym
levels.teaser: Gym: a three-screen shape plate on 1-6-5, four numbered yellow mats giving 6098 on locker 1, the weight rack colour count feeding 3516 into the exercise bike console and a treadmill arrow run.

levels.name: Candy Shop
levels.teaser: Candy Shop: a jar weighed on the scale at 6841 to set the four-wheel drawer lock, a memory game over ice creams, a sweet sudoku, the letter board that spells G6H8 and the exit door.

levels.name: Food Court
levels.teaser: Food Court: a smoothie blended to 350 ml for the till code, a card paid under the name MARIA, 53402 at the back-office terminal and the three-letter lock that takes ZCO.

levels.name: Pet Shop
levels.teaser: Pet Shop: green arrows on a drawer, a cage stack and a dot panel, a tap handle for the parrot water dispenser, the fish temperature chart and the aquarium thermostat set to 053.6 F to drop the chest.

levels.name: Indoor Playground
levels.teaser: Indoor Playground: a soft-play hall dressed as a garden, a piece of paper reading 3764 and a four-wheel chest that opens on the exit key.

levels.name: Restaurant
levels.teaser: Restaurant: a four-drink chalkboard, a briefcase on 6743, a plate-and-fork total of 18, a nut-sort board, pizza assembly and the four-letter lock that spells FOOD.

levels.name: DIY Shop
levels.teaser: DIY Shop: a sticky note reading 51432, a five-dial lock on 42130, the blueprint letters G D C, tracing paper 954 and three gas valves that pay out the coins.

levels.name: Jewelry Store
levels.teaser: Jewelry Store: a nine-necklace rack, a five-pendant colour puzzle, seven watch-jigsaw pieces that print the four door digits, and a double door with green dial panes plus a key lock.

levels.name: Grocery Store
levels.teaser: Grocery Store: a wallet that dismantles into a coin and the 58431267 Code card, an eight-button vent panel, a five-dial drinks-fridge code 02725 and the 65219 till code.

levels.name: Exchange Office
levels.teaser: Exchange Office: a hidden calculator holding five rates, a six-wheel rate board, the laptop password 6795 and a six-button symbol keypad on the door.

levels.name: Fashion Store
levels.teaser: Fashion Store: a handwritten bill totalling 363,99, the register keypad, a barcode scan that returns 30015 and the door keypad that ends the level.

levels.name: Art Supplies Store
levels.teaser: Art Supplies Store: the 052 drawer code, two colour-button locks, a mandala canvas to finish and the heart key that ends the level for +50 coins.

levels.name: Shoe Store
levels.teaser: Shoe Store: an arithmetic box whose answer is 96, a number panel of three totals (31, 23, 18), the till code 2120 and the five-symbol locker that frees the exit sneaker.

levels.name: Sports Store
levels.teaser: Sports Store: The seven cap colours that give the till passcode 6273519, the gym slide puzzle that drops a Key, the hoodie-and-ball icon puzzle and the five billiard balls 8-4-3-7-1 that set the exit keypad to 84371.

levels.name: Bookstore
levels.teaser: Bookstore: The poster counts Pink 1, Red 6, Purple 4, Yellow 3 that open the back-room door, the four plates E=5 X=8 I=3 T=1 that spell 5831 on the EXIT keypad, and the +50 coin finish.

levels.name: Furniture Store
levels.teaser: Furniture Store: The four carpet parts and the round rug, the yellow safe that takes 693, the oven panel that takes 12:08, the tangram board that yields the Mirror, the mirrored paper that turns 12850 into the till code 02851, and the ID card that opens the exit.

levels.name: Household Appliances
levels.teaser: Household Appliances: The note that counts circles, the TV that prints 1286, the pink four-dial lock, the key it hides and the exit worth +50 coins.

levels.name: Print Shop
levels.teaser: Print Shop: The four jersey numbers behind the till code 133951, the CD in the cash drawer, the ink cartridge that unfreezes the big printer, the six-segment wheel whose missing number is 54, and the printed sheet that feeds the exit door — whose keypad takes a different one of its six numbers in every playthrough.

levels.name: Bakery
levels.teaser: Bakery: The two three-window drawer locks (421 on the coloured dial, 693 from the slip of paper in the cake case), the cupcake recipe at 35 minutes and 250 degrees, the six-switch fuse box, and the silver stand that hands you the exit key for +50 coins.

levels.name: Toy Store
levels.teaser: Toy Store: The block train, the semaphore chart that spells TRAIN, the heart-box colour grid, the balloon tunnel gate and the key that opens the exit.

levels.name: Restroom
levels.teaser: Restroom: The drain ring that has to total 61, the four grid papers and the twenty-nine clicks they add up to, the two restrooms on either side of the corridor, and the +50 coin finish.

levels.name: Parking
levels.teaser: Parking: The paperclip and the lift hatch, the three plates 1876 / 3542 / 2002 on floor -2, the five-fader panel, the C B A D keypad that takes 0243, and the ride to P that ends Chapter 2.
